sections.title: The same form, a new job
sections.content: You already know the 1st-person plural imperative (-junk/-jünk) for "let's..." from cooking together and from asking Mit csináljak? Said as a question instead of a flat statement, that exact same form becomes a suggestion: Menjünk moziba? doesn't announce that you're going — it asks whether you should, together. Nothing new to build; just a new use for a form you already have.

sections.title: Suggestions with -junk/-jünk
rows: Shall we go to the cinema?

items.english: Shall we go to the cinema tonight?

items.spanish: Ne menjünk túl későn, korán kezdődik a film.
items.english: Let's not go too late, the movie starts early.

sections.content: ne in front of the same form makes a negative suggestion — Ne menjünk moziba ("Let's not go to the cinema") — exactly the same ne you already use with any other imperative.
